mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals monetary easing, reducing discount rates for equity valuation and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines by at least 0.25 percentage points over the prior month.

mechanism_narrative: A month-over-month increase in CPIAUCSL exceeding 0.5% signals persistent inflation, triggering central bank hawkishness and reducing equity valuations, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when CPIAUCSL rises > 0.5% month-over-month.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in residential sales (RSAFS) and housing starts (HOUST) indicate robust consumer spending and economic expansion, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days through earnings momentum.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when both RSAFS and HOUST rise by at least 0.5% month-over-month.

mechanism_narrative: In a low unemployment regime (UNRATE < 4.0%), tight labor market conditions support consumer spending and corporate profitability, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE is below 4.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A year-over-year decline in industrial production (INDPRO) exceeding 1.0% signals manufacturing contraction and economic slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO falls > 1.0% year-over-year.

mechanism_narrative: A month-over-month decline in housing starts (HOUST) exceeding 2.0% indicates weakening residential demand and broader economic contraction, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when HOUST falls > 2.0% month-over-month.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) over the prior month signals immediate monetary easing, boosting short-term equity returns and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines by at least 0.25 percentage points over the prior month.

mechanism_narrative: A month-over-month increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) exceeding 100,000 jobs indicates robust labor market strength, supporting consumer spending and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when PAYEMS rises > 100k month-over-month.
